name: Broken Pencil
tagline: Draw it. Guess it. Watch it fall apart.
description: Telephone with a pencil. Pick a secret word, draw it on your phone, pass the book on: the next player guesses, the one after draws that guess, and so on around the circle. Then the TV turns the pages of every book one at a time while the VIP holds the Next button. No points — the show is the game.

settings.label: Players per book
settings.description: How many other players touch each book. 15 = everyone (the full circle).

settings.label: Custom words
settings.description: Let players type their own secret word

settings.label: Spicy words
settings.description: Adds cheekier words to the offers (PG-13)
